title: Native cochain open tensor projection comparison
statement: For any native open tensor datum, the actual native sum-total tensor of extension by zero of a U-complex with a Z-complex is naturally isomorphic to extension by zero of its tensor with the termwise restriction of the Z-complex.

source.place: lemma-pullback-tensor-product; lemma-j-shriek-and-tensor; totalization of the sheaf comparisons

proof.text: Totalize the natural sheaf projection comparison. The relevant open functor is a left adjoint, hence preserves countable diagonal coproducts. The generic total comparison API proves the inverse identities, differential compatibility, and naturality. For projection totalize the inverse and then invert the resulting comparison.

theorem native_open_tensor_chain_projection (s : NativeOpenTensorData k₀ l j) :
    Nonempty (((extensionByZero k₀ l j).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).prod (𝟭 _) ⋙
      Functor.uncurry.obj (nativeTensorTotal k₀ l Z) ≅
        (𝟭 _).prod ((upperStar k₀ l j).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)) ⋙
          Functor.uncurry.obj (nativeTensorTotal k₀ l U) ⋙
            (extensionByZero k₀ l j).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ))
